import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

data = pd.read_csv('data.csv')

bmi_groups = data.groupby('BMI Category')[['Sleep Duration', 'Quality of Sleep']].mean().reset_index()

bmi_categories = bmi_groups['BMI Category'].unique()
x_indexes = range(len(bmi_categories))
bar_width = 0.4

plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.set_style('whitegrid')

sleep_duration = bmi_groups['Sleep Duration'].values
quality_of_sleep = bmi_groups['Quality of Sleep'].values

plt.bar(x_indexes, sleep_duration, width=bar_width, label='Sleep Duration', color='#1f77b4')
plt.bar([i + bar_width for i in x_indexes], quality_of_sleep, width=bar_width, label='Quality of Sleep', color='#ff7f0e')

plt.xlabel('BMI Category')
plt.ylabel('Average Value')
plt.title('Average Sleep Duration and Quality by BMI Category')
plt.xticks([i + bar_width/2 for i in x_indexes], bmi_categories)
plt.legend()

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png')
plt.close()
